integrity: Proof is self-contained except for standard Fourier orthogonality and the Basel sum, both explicitly used. Exact rational checker is supplemental, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Lebesgue phase-space carry law; no assertion of arithmetic independence of p-adic phases or of valuations over integer samples; no mutual independence within the noncentral vector; older implicit equivalent possible.
title: Maximal collective independence and a sharp parity obstruction for Kummer carry profiles
